help.title: How to Play
help.goal_text: Fill cells with Water (💧) and Boats (⛵) according to row, column, and other hints without making mistakes. You can mark empty cells with Air (✕) if it helps.
help.recovery_note_before: If you also play on Steam or are moving from another browser, copy its Account Recovery Key from Account Settings and restore it
help.recovery_note_after: to keep your leaderboard presence and streak.

aquariums.name: Aquariums & Gravity
aquariums.desc: Thick borders divide the grid into separate aquariums. You fill cells with water, which falls according to gravity.

lineNumbers.name: Row & Column Hints
lineNumbers.desc: Numbers outside the grid indicate the exact amount of water cells required in that row or column.

boats.name: Boats
boats.desc: Boats float on top of water. The cell directly below a boat must have water.

diagonals.name: Diagonals
diagonals.desc: Diagonal walls split a cell into half-cells. Each filled half-cell counts as 0.5 waters.

aquariumHints.name: Aquarium Hints
aquariumHints.desc: These tell you how many aquariums with a certain amount of water are present in the level.

unknownHints.name: Unknown Hints (?)
unknownHints.desc: A question mark indicates a contiguous water group of unknown size (at least 1 cell).

togetherSeparate.name: Together & Separate Hints
togetherSeparate.desc:
{N} indicates that the water in that row/column are contiguous.
-N- indicates that they are not (there is at least one empty cell in the middle).

fri.name: Freaky Friday
fri.desc: Every rule, everywhere, all at once.

sat.name: One Row Saturday
sat.desc: Only one row hint is visible.

sun.name: Aquarium Sunday
sun.desc: Diagonals and many aquarium hints visible.

account.title: Player Account & Profile
account.subtitle: Manage your public name, avatar, and cloud recovery key
account.display_name_hint: Your name appears on the daily leaderboard. Must be between 3 and 25 characters.
account.recovery_key_desc: This secret key identifies your player profile on PlayFab. Save it to keep your leaderboard submissions, rank and streak if you switch browsers or devices. Restore the key from the Steam version to share the streak.
account.err_name_length: Display name must be between 3 and 25 characters
account.err_empty_key: Please enter a valid recovery key
account.err_same_key: This is already the currently active account key
account.confirm_restore: Restoring this key will switch your browser session to that account. Continue?
